## Biography

The Southern Crown. A constellation, a direction, a boundary.

In the early days of the Alliance, an expedition led by Captain Hieronymus Halsey pushed toward Corona Australis and beyond. Their last broadcast came shortly after passing this marker: they had barely cleared the nebula's edge before contact failed. The Alliance, then still young and cautious, buried the loss. Cal remembered. He spoke of it to Hermine Delarue centuries later, connecting the Halsey family tragedy to the disintegration of GalCop and the Turners' subsequent rise on Alioth.

Corona Australis represents the point where exploration becomes sacrifice. Where the map ends not with a warning but with silence. Pilots still pass through on deep-space routes. Most see only stars and dust. A few — those who know the history — slow down and listen.
